grievances.rawInput: Ward 3 Gali No. 4 me sewer water overflowing for 5 days. Urgent super sucker needed!

aiKeyEntities.urgencyReason: Persistent sewer overflow for 5 days creates severe contamination and health hazards

grievances.aiSuggestedAction: Immediately dispatch a super sucker machine to Ward 3, Gali No. 4 and clear the sewer blockage.

grievances.rawInput: [Voice Note Transcript]: Namaste MP Sahib, Ceylon intersection street lights in Lanka ward have been dead for 4 nights. Female BHU students facing harassment risk in darkness. Please fix immediately.
grievances.aiSummary: Street lights at Ceylon intersection in Lanka ward have been non-functional for four nights, creating a high risk of harassment for female BHU students. Immediate restoration of public lighting is required to ensure women's safety.

aiKeyEntities.urgencyReason: Safety and harassment risk for female BHU students due to 4 days of total darkness

grievances.officerInCharge: Er. A. K. Verma (Chief Executive Engineer)
grievances.aiSuggestedAction: Direct the Executive Engineer (Electrical) to immediately dispatch a field repair team to Ceylon intersection to replace fault fittings/lines today.

generatedConstituentReply.en: Namaste Vikram Pratap Singh ji, your complaint regarding the dead streetlights at Ceylon intersection has been registered on priority under Ticket #TICKET_ID. The Municipal Electrical Department has been instructed to fix the lights today for student safety. - LokSeva MP Office

grievances.rawInput: आदरणीय सांसद जी, चौक रेशम बुनकर वार्ड नंबर 3 में पिछले 12 दिनों से मुख्य सीवर लाइन पूरी तरह बंद है। गंदा पानी सड़कों पर फैल रहा है जिससे पावरलूम और करघों पर काम करना असंभव हो गया है। लगभग 250 बुनकर परिवारों का रोजगार प्रभावित है। डेंगू फैलने का भारी खतरा है। जल कल विभाग को 4 बार लिखित शिकायत दी पर कोई कार्रवाई नहीं हुई। कृपया तुरंत सुपर-सकर मशीन भिजवाकर राहत प्रदान करें।
grievances.aiSummary: Severe sewer blockage in Ward 3 affecting 250 weaver households and looms. SLA breached & escalated to MP Command Desk for emergency desilting.
grievances.officerInCharge: Er. A. K. Verma (Chief Executive Engineer)
grievances.aiSuggestedAction: Dispatch emergency jetting/super-sucker machine within 4 hours. Sanction fast-track pipeline desilting under Ward Urgent Repairs Fund.

generatedConstituentReply.hi: प्रिय रामेश्वर प्रसाद जी, आपकी शिकायत (टिकट #LOK-2026-0841) पर सांसद कार्यालय द्वारा तुरंत संज्ञान लिया गया है। जल कल विभाग के अधिशासी अभियंता इं. अनिल वर्मा को 4 घंटे में सुपर-सकर मशीन भेजने और सीवर लाइन साफ करने का कड़ा निर्देश दिया गया है। निगरानी हेतु नोडल अधिकारी तैनात है।
generatedConstituentReply.en: Dear Rameshwar Prasad ji, your grievance (Ticket #LOK-2026-0841) has been escalated by the MP Office on top priority. Executive Engineer Er. Anil Verma has been instructed to deploy jetting machines within 4 hours. A nodal officer is tracking resolution.

grievances.rawInput: [Transcript of audio note recorded at Ward 5 Shivpur Chowk]: Namaste MP Sir, hum Shivpur Ward 5 se bol rahe hain. Yahan primary school ke paas wala rasta completely toota hua hai aur raat ko koi streetlight nahi jalti. Pichle hafte do school bache dark me gir kar chotil ho gaye. Barish me paani bhar jata hai. Kripya naye LED light aur sadak marammat karwayein.
grievances.locationDetails: Near Primary School Main Approach Road, Shivpur
grievances.aiSummary: Broken approach road and missing streetlights near primary school in Ward 5. Hazards causing injuries to children during nighttime and monsoon waterlogging.

aiKeyEntities.location: Primary School Approach Road, Ward 5 Shivpur
aiKeyEntities.urgencyReason: Child safety hazard & dark spot accidents

grievances.assignedDepartment: PWD Road Construction & Municipal Electrical Dept
grievances.aiSuggestedAction: Approve installation of 8 Solar/LED street poles under Ward Infrastructure Upgrade fund and patch main pothole stretch within 72 hours.

generatedConstituentReply.hi: आदरणीय सुनीता देवी जी, शिवपुर प्राथमिक विद्यालय मार्ग पर स्ट्रीटलाइट एवं सड़क मरम्मत का टिकट #LOK-2026-0842 दर्ज कर लिया गया है। विद्युत विभाग को तुरंत LED पोल लगाने एवं PWD को गड्ढा भरने का आदेश जारी कर दिया गया है।
generatedConstituentReply.en: Respected Sunita Devi ji, ticket #LOK-2026-0842 regarding Shivpur school road repairs and streetlights has been logged. Instructions issued to install LED lights and repair potholes within 3 days.

grievances.rawInput: Respected Member of Parliament, Dashashwamedh Ward 1 community health centre has been facing acute shortage of essential typhoid & anti-rabies vaccines for 3 weeks.
